item.title: Report totals by account and currency
item.brief: Update the Python CSV reporting program to read currency-aware CSV while remaining compatible with legacy CSV without a currency column (default USD). Validate exact three uppercase ASCII letters and on invalid currency print an error to stderr and exit 2. Aggregate by account and currency and emit header account,currency,total_cents with rows sorted by account then currency. Update README, add/update tests including legacy compatibility and malformed codes, run python3 -m unittest, and commit the change locally. Do not push.

item.title: Emit and validate transaction currencies in ledger
item.brief: Update the Rust TSV-to-CSV program to accept optional fourth-field ISO currency codes, default absent values to USD, and emit the currency CSV column on all rows. Validate exact three uppercase ASCII letters; on invalid currency print an error naming the input line number to stderr and exit 2, while other input errors retain exit 1. Update README, add/update tests including defaults, valid/invalid values and line reporting, run cargo test, and commit the change locally. Do not push.

Updated README.md and added parsing and CLI regression coverage, including line reporting and exit 1 for other input errors. Verified with cargo fmt --check, cargo test (4 passed), and git diff --check. No behavior outside the requested currency changes was intended.
